answers.prompt: In two short sentences for a 14-year-old, explain what 10 mm of rain means in a weather forecast.
answers.answer: Sample answer: 10 mm of rain means the water would be 10 millimetres deep if it collected in a flat tray. The bigger the number, the more rain.

answers.prompt: Give a 14-year-old three short tips for revising for an exam, in plain words.
answers.answer: Sample answer: Revise a little every day instead of all at once. Test yourself with questions instead of rereading notes. Take short breaks.
